hypothesis: A fixed small nonlinear symmetric pair probe may reveal conditional same-B/cross-B information in the frozen native encoder that the near-stationary linear probe and native assignment fail to use. This is a readability diagnostic, not an encoder intervention or deployable reconstruction claim.
changed_factor: Finite nonlinear probe (256→64 GELU→1) versus matched within-event shuffled-B-label null; compare descriptively with already optimized linear and native scores on identical event-disjoint train-role assessment identities. No search over architectures, learning rates or checkpoints.
control: Same frozen features, original train-role split and feature normalizer, same initialized nonlinear head and event/class sample order. Null permutes B labels within each fitting event preserving B/background/unknown support and class sizes. Existing Phase79 optimized linear probe and native conditional assignment are fixed references.
target_contract: Symmetric same-B versus cross-B classification of known source-disjoint pairs within each event; no globally fixed B identity. Truth used only fitting supervision/evaluation. Score all detector-source-disjoint pairs before joining truth; background-containing scores are diagnostic support controls, not a trained foreground detector. No probe output enters deployed assignment.

mechanism_evidence.measured_effect: Phase81 explicit factorized pair likelihood changes foreground tradeoff but not conditional partition (main raw/accepted0/1024;refinement pairAUC declines). Phase79 near-stationary linear probe does not reliably beat native. Nonlinear readability remains unresolved.

data_and_compute_control.model: Fixed authenticated native encoder/checkpoints; no encoder forwards or updates. Reuse Phase78 detector-only frozen traces after Phase81 exact native tensor replay.
data_and_compute_control.partition: Same SHA256 phase78-probe UID ranking:192fit/64assessment per each6categories;384eligibleBfit/128Bassessment; no validation/test.
data_and_compute_control.features: Original256 symmetric abs-difference/product features of128context; same fixed fit-only mean/std as original true-label probe. No widths/geometry/normalization changes to scientific model.
data_and_compute_control.optimizer: AdamW lr0.001 weight_decay0.0001; gradient norm clip5; seed8209, no schedule
data_and_compute_control.initialization: Same Torch seed and exact initial state for true/null heads
data_and_compute_control.risk_measurements: Exact event/class-balanced fitting risk at0 and every256updates, final gradient; fixed final checkpoint, no assessment-based selection. Nonconvex convergence not assumed.
data_and_compute_control.compute_disclosure: Probe fitting is training, not zero optimization; report actual pair/unique-event presentations,parameters,time,RSS and full-risk passes. Do not claim equal FLOPs versus prior linear probe.

stop_rule: One fixed true/null diagnostic only. Fail closed on binding/role/gradient/nonfinite/resource errors. No refit or hyperparameter tuning after assessment. Stop unsupported scientific successors if no new mechanism is demonstrated; do not consume fresh validation for a failed probe.
success_rule: Evidence of unused readability requires event-stratified paired95%interval above0 versus BOTH native and near-stationary linear reference on the fixed train-role assessment partition, plus true>null control. Background outputs must be disclosed; even a pass is only exploratory mechanism evidence, not membership efficiency or primary eligibility.
validation_selection: No validation designation/access/model evaluation. Fixed train-role assessment excludes probe fitting events, but those identities are within the scientific-model training role; not independent physics confirmation. No checkpoint/threshold selection on assessment.
